lines: Can a part hold the whole?
部分，能承载整体吗？
An old image says yes. Indra's net: every jewel reflects every other jewel. Break off one pearl, and the whole net is still inside it.
一个古老的意象说：能。因陀罗网——每一颗宝珠都映照着其余所有宝珠。取下一颗，整张网仍在其中。
Physics has its own version: the hologram, where a boundary encodes a volume.
物理学也有自己的版本：全息图——边界编码了体积。
But an image is not a proof. So this project asks the question exactly: which parts hold which wholes, and where does the reflection break?
但意象不是证明。所以这个项目把问题问得精确：哪些部分承载哪些整体？映照又在哪里破碎？
Start with one law, proved in Lean. Every observation folds the world into fibers: sets of states that look the same.
从一条在 Lean 中证明的定律开始：每一次观察，都把世界折叠成纤维——一组组看起来相同的状态。
A hidden target can be recovered from what you see exactly when it is constant on every fiber.
一个隐藏的目标能从所见之中恢复，当且仅当它在每一条纤维上都是常数。
That is the whole hologram question, in one line. Everything else in this film is about where that line is crossed.
这就是全息问题的全部，浓缩成一行。本片其余的一切，都关于这条线在哪里被越过。

Sometimes local views do glue into a whole. Arrange local records on a tree. If every variable lives on a connected branch, and neighbours agree exactly on their overlap, then every local record extends to a global one.
有时，局部视图确实能拼成整体。把局部记录排在一棵树上：只要每个变量都落在连通的一枝上，相邻者在重叠处完全一致，那么每一份局部记录都能延拓成全局记录。
Existence is proved. Uniqueness, the original history, and the cost are not. The project says so.
存在性已被证明。唯一性、原始历史、计算代价——尚未。项目如实写明。
And sometimes the parts lie by omission. An entangled Bell pair and a classical coin flip look identical qubit by qubit.
而有时，部分以沉默撒谎。一对纠缠的贝尔态，和一次经典的掷硬币，逐个量子比特看完全相同。
The whole lives in a hidden correlation sector, orthogonal to every local view. For two qubits, nine dimensions of it.
整体藏在一个隐藏的关联扇区里，与每一个局部视角都正交。对两个量子比特，它有九个维度。
Now the frontier. These newest results were derived on paper in the last few days, and are not yet machine-checked.
现在进入前沿。以下最新结果是最近几天在纸面上推导的，尚未经过机器核验。
First: a system leaves traces in its environment. Can it be restored? In one explicit four-path model, a single record gives zero chance of exact recovery.
第一：一个系统在环境中留下痕迹。它还能被复原吗？在一个明确的四路径模型里，只留一份记录，精确复原的机会是零。
Two records, with full joint access, and recovery becomes certain. The threshold is exactly two. The certificate is a cube of ten phase vectors.
两份记录、完整的联合访问——复原就成了确定的事。阈值恰好是二。证书是十个相位向量组成的立方。
Second: can quantum states be stored in real numbers alone, with the imaginary part thrown away?
第二：量子态能否只用实数存储，把虚部丢掉？
There is a price. Recovery error plus the leftover non-real part can never fall below a gap, delta. For six states on the three axes, that gap is exactly a third of their radius.
这有代价。恢复误差，加上残余的非实部分，永远不能低于一个间隙 δ。对三条轴上的六个态，这个间隙恰好是半径的三分之一。
And a hidden triangle decides everything: real storage costs nothing extra exactly when the reciprocals of the three radii form a triangle.
一个隐藏的三角形决定一切：实数存储不付额外代价，当且仅当三个半径的倒数能构成三角形。
Squeeze one axis toward zero, and the best error does not fade away. It stays at one quarter, then jumps to zero at the very end. A discontinuity in reality itself.
把一条轴压向零，最佳误差不会渐渐消失。它停在四分之一，直到最后一刻才跳到零。这是“实在”本身的一次断裂。
Third: recovery has phase boundaries. Through a noisy channel, the best error starts at three quarters, and crosses that line at exactly one threshold.
第三：恢复有相边界。穿过一条带噪声的信道，最佳误差从四分之三出发，恰在唯一一个阈值处越过这条线。
Inside the math, a point slides across a quarter disc until it touches the edge. At that contact, the optimal decoder changes shape, from three operators to two.
在数学内部，一个点在四分之一圆盘里滑行，直到触碰边缘。在那个接触点，最优解码器改变了形态——从三个算子变成两个。
Capacity, smoothness, and visible error turn out to be three different things. The world does not bend where you expect.
容量、光滑性、可见误差，原来是三种不同的东西。世界并不在你预期的地方弯折。
Fourth: the deepest question in number theory, recast as a phase transition.
第四：数论中最深的问题，被重铸为一次相变。
Suppose the Riemann hypothesis were false. Then there is a first height where a zero leaves the critical line, and it cannot leave alone: a mirror zero appears beside it.
假设黎曼猜想不成立。那么必有一个最早的高度，零点在那里离开临界线——而且它不能独自离开：一个镜像零点在它身旁出现。
At that height, an order parameter jumps from zero. On the Lee-Yang circle, two roots split apart, to r and one over r. The zeros would undergo an instantaneous phase transition.
在那个高度，一个序参量从零跳起。在李-杨圆上，两个根分裂开来，一个到 r，一个到 1/r。零点将经历一次瞬时相变。
This is conditional. It proves nothing about the hypothesis. One load-bearing bridge is still open, and it is named. Either way, the work produces truth.
这是有条件的。它没有证明任何关于猜想的事。仍有一座承重之桥是开放的，并且被点了名。无论真假，这项工作都在产出真理。
Meanwhile, the machine keeps settling what others left open. Every result here passed the Lean kernel.
与此同时，机器不断了结别人留下的开放问题。以下每一条都通过了 Lean 内核。
A March twenty twenty-six conjecture on rotating three letters in binary words: diameter L times N minus L, over two, rounded up. Proved for all sizes.
2026 年 3 月的一个猜想：在二进制词里旋转三个相邻字母，图的直径是 L(N−L)/2 向上取整。对所有规模证明。
The generalized Petersen graphs: zero forcing number eight, for every n from thirteen on. The paper had only checked up to twenty.
广义彼得森图：从 13 起的每一个 n，零强迫数都是 8。原论文只验证到 20。
A quantum walk conjecture from August: refuted on a graph with thirty vertices. An OEIS formula from nuclear magnetic resonance: it breaks at n equals nineteen.
八月的一个量子行走猜想：在一个 30 个顶点的图上被推翻。一个来自核磁共振的 OEIS 公式：在 n = 19 处断裂。
Four hundred and eleven dossiers. No priority claimed. Only kernel-checked.
四百一十一份卷宗。不声称优先权。只认内核核验。

Some truths are about returning. Watch any continuous reading of a rotation on a torus, even with an error that fades away: it comes back to every open window it can reach, again and again, with bounded gaps.
有些真理关于回返。观察环面上一次旋转的任意连续读数，即使带着逐渐消失的误差：它会一次又一次回到它能抵达的每一扇开窗，间隔有界。
Proved, and frozen. A small theorem about eternal return.
已证明，已冻结。一条关于永恒回返的小定理。
So is the library itself a hologram? Each frozen node is addressed by the hashes of all its ancestors. It carries its whole past.
那么，这座图书馆本身是全息的吗？每一个冻结的节点，都由它全部祖先的哈希来寻址。它携带着自己的全部过去。
But not its future, and not its siblings. Depending on your ancestors is not the same as containing the whole net. The project draws that line explicitly.
但不携带未来，也不携带兄弟。依赖祖先，并不等于包含整张网。项目明确划出了这条线。
That is the honest hologram: not every part holds the whole. Finding exactly which parts do is the frontier.
这是诚实的全息：并非每个部分都承载整体。精确找出哪些部分承载，正是前沿。
Five thousand files. Nearly thirty thousand theorems. Nearly five thousand frozen truths, each one a mirror facing the dark.
五千个文件。近三万条定理。近五千条冻结的真理，每一条都是一面朝向黑暗的镜子。
Where does information still escape? Follow it. That is where the next truth is waiting.
信息还在哪里逃逸？追随它。下一条真理，就在那里等待。
